observation.command:
cd /workspace && readarray -t S < /tmp/secrets.txt && SUPER="${S[0]}" && SECRETS="${S[1]}" && MEDIA="${S[2]}" && DBPASS="${S[3]}" && cp .env.example .env && sed -i \
 -e "s|^ENVIRONMENT=.*|ENVIRONMENT=production|" \
 -e "s|^CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN=.*|CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN=http://localhost:4000|" \
 -e "s|^FRONTEND_DOMAIN=.*|FRONTEND_DOMAIN=http://localhost:3000|" \
 -e "s|^NEXT_PUBLIC_CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN=.*|NEXT_PUBLIC_CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN=http://localhost:4000|" \
 -e "s|^TRUST_PROXY=.*|TRUST_PROXY=0|" \
 -e "s|^AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=.*|AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=1000|" \
 -e "s|^DB_PASS=.*|DB_PASS=${DBPASS}|" \
 -e "s|^SUPER_ADMIN_API_KEY=.*|SUPER_ADMIN_API_KEY=${SUPER}|" \
 -e "s|^SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY=.*|SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY=${SECRETS}|" \
 -e "s|^MEDIA_URL_SIGNING_KEY=.*|MEDIA_URL_SIGNING_KEY=${MEDIA}|" \
 -e "s|^SMTP_ENABLED=.*|SMTP_ENABLED=true|" \
 -e "s|^SMTP_HOST=.*|SMTP_HOST=smtp.example.org|" \
 -e "s|^SMTP_USERNAME=.*|SMTP_USERNAME=daz|" \
 -e "s|^SMTP_PASSWORD=.*|SMTP_PASSWORD=dazpass|" \
 -e "s|^SMTP_FROM_EMAIL=.*|SMTP_FROM_EMAIL=noreply@example.org|" \
 .env && chmod 600 .env && grep -nE "^(ENVIRONMENT|CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN|FRONTEND_DOMAIN|NEXT_PUBLIC_CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN|TRUST_PROXY|AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX|DB_PASS|SUPER_ADMIN_API_KEY|SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY|MEDIA_URL_SIGNING_KEY|SMTP_)" .env | sed 's/\(KEY=\|PASS=\).*/\1<redacted>/'
